en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 24. Abu `Abd Allah al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ushnani al-Razi the jurist in Balkh said tha `Ali ibn Mihrawayh al-Quzwini said on the authority of Dawud ibn Sulayman al-Farra’, on the authority of `Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (AS) on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers (AS), on the authority of `Ali (AS) that The Messenger of Allah (SA) said: “
Divine unity is half of faith And increase your sustenance by means of charity.”
